Namespaces.Name: Linux
Namespaces.Doc: Runtime options specific to desktop Linux.

Options.Name: EnablePulseAudio
Options.Doc:
Allow using the PulseAudio API when it is installed in the operating environment.

When both PulseAudio and ALSA are enabled and available, PulseAudio is always chosen over ALSA.

Options.Name: EnableALSA
Options.Doc:
Allow using the ALSA API when it is installed in the operating environment.

When both PulseAudio and ALSA are enabled and available, PulseAudio is always chosen over ALSA.

Options.Name: AudioOutputFormat
Options.Doc:
Audio format that is sent out to the system.

This is supported by PulseAudio only.
